newsitem.title: FRANCE: Details of April 29 Turkish barley export tender.
newsitem.headline: Details of April 29 Turkish barley export tender.

text.p: Turkey's export tender on April 29 for 150,000 tonnes of barley, announced this week, contains the following shipments, European grain traders said on Thursday.
Traders must submit bids for a minimum 10,000 tonnes by April 29 at 1000 Ankara time. Tolerance on the export quantity is plus or minus five percent, traders said.
Turkish state grain board TMO is selling the barley from its stocks of about 300,000 tonnes with the rest to be held back for emergencies, Turkish officials said earlier this week.

TMO cancelled a previous export tender for 150,000 tonnes of feed and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley in February, citing unsatisfactory prices. Traders had bid between $121.46 and $133.06 per tonne of feed barley.
World prices for competing western European feed barley for May export are currently seen in the low $130s per tonne.
